```{r}
#Figure 6G
mat <- as.matrix(fltlog_TPM_Data)
mode(mat) <- "numeric"
pca <- prcomp(t(mat), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x)

pca_df$Treatment <- metaData2$Treatment
pca_df$Replicate <- metaData2$Replicate
pca_df$Batch     <- metaData2$Batch
pca_df$Timepoint <- metaData2$Timepoint

pdf("PC1_PC4.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
ggplot(pca_df,
       aes(x = PC1,
           y = PC4,
           color = Treatment,
           shape = Timepoint)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Replicate),
                  size = 4,
                  show.legend = FALSE) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1, ", round(summary(pca)$importance[2,1] * 100, 2), "% variation")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC4, ", round(summary(pca)$importance[2,4] * 100, 2), "% variation")) +
  theme_classic()
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#Figure 6H
#DGE Analysis for Day 7 samples 
countData_CT7_AT7 <- countData[, c(
  "CT7.1", "CT7.2", "CT7.3",
  "AT7.1", "AT7.2", "AT7.3"
)]

countData_CT7_AT7$CT7.1  <- as.integer (countData_CT7_AT7$CT7.1)
countData_CT7_AT7$CT7.2  <- as.integer (countData_CT7_AT7$CT7.2)
countData_CT7_AT7$CT7.3  <- as.integer (countData_CT7_AT7$CT7.3)
countData_CT7_AT7$AT7.1  <- as.integer (countData_CT7_AT7$AT7.1)
countData_CT7_AT7$AT7.2  <- as.integer (countData_CT7_AT7$AT7.2)
countData_CT7_AT7$AT7.3  <- as.integer (countData_CT7_AT7$AT7.3)

keep_samples <- c(
  "CT7.1", "CT7.2", "CT7.3",
  "AT7.1", "AT7.2", "AT7.3"
)
metadata_CT7_AT7 <- metaData2[rownames(metaData2) %in% keep_samples, ]
metadata_CT7_AT7 <- metadata_CT7_AT7[keep_samples, ]
all(rownames(metadata_CT7_AT7) == keep_samples)

counts          <- as.matrix  (countData_CT7_AT7)
meta            <- as.matrix  (metadata_CT7_AT7)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(counts),
  colData = meta,
  design = ~ Replicate + Treatment
)

dds$Treatment <- factor(dds$Treatment, levels = c("1", "2"))

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]

dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds)

resSig <- subset(res, padj < 0.05)
resSig_df <- as.data.frame(resSig)

top50_sig <- resSig_df[order(resSig_df$padj), ][1:50, ]
data <- as.data.frame      (resSig)
data <- rownames_to_column (data, "Symbol")
write.xlsx(data,"D7_DGE.xlsx")

keyvals  <- ifelse (res$log2FoldChange <= -1 & res$pvalue <= 10e-5, "#76d6ffff",
                   ifelse (res$log2FoldChange >=  1 & res$pvalue <= 10e-5, "#5e5e5eff", "#D9D9D9FF"))

names (keyvals) <- ifelse (res$log2FoldChange <= -1 & res$pvalue <= 10e-5, "Control Day 7",
                   ifelse (res$log2FoldChange >=  1 & res$pvalue <= 10e-5, "ARNT Day 7", "NS"))

keygenes <- c("IGFBP3", "ARNT", "FN1", "PLAC8", "HLA-G", "CYP19A1", "CGA", "CGB5", "ERVV-2", "ERVFRD-1")

pdf("Day7DGE.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
EnhancedVolcano (res,
                 lab             = rownames (res),
                 x               = "log2FoldChange",
                 y               = "padj",
                 FCcutoff        = 0.5,
                 pCutoff         = 10e-5,
                 pointSize       = 2.0,
                 colCustom       = keyvals,
                 colAlpha        = 1,
                 selectLab = keygenes,
                 xlim            = c(-4, 4),
                 ylim            = c(0, 150),
                 gridlines.major = FALSE,
                 drawConnectors  = FALSE, 
                 gridlines.minor = FALSE) + ggtitle (NULL)
```

```{r}
#Figure 6I
#Interaction Analysis 
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(counts),
  colData = meta,
  design = ~ Replicate + Timepoint + Treatment + Timepoint:Treatment
)

# filter low expression genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]

# run DESeq
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# results
resultsNames(dds)

res_time <- results(dds, name = "Timepoint_3_vs_0")
res_interaction <- results(dds, name = "Timepoint3.Treatment2")
time_df <- as.data.frame(res_time)
time_df$Gene <- rownames(time_df)

interaction_df <- as.data.frame(res_interaction)
interaction_df$Gene <- rownames(interaction_df)

combined <- merge(
  time_df[, c("Gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj")],
  interaction_df[, c("Gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj")],
  by = "Gene",
  suffixes = c("_time", "_interaction")
)
HIF_independent <- combined[
  !is.na(combined$padj_time) &
  !is.na(combined$padj_interaction) &
  combined$padj_time < 0.05 &
  combined$log2FoldChange_time > 1 &
  combined$padj_interaction > 0.05,
]

data <- as.data.frame      (HIF_independent)
data <- rownames_to_column (data, "Symbol")
write.xlsx(data,"HIF_Independent_Day3.xlsx")
norm_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
HIF_independent$mean_expression <- rowMeans(
  norm_counts[HIF_independent$Gene, ]
)
summary(HIF_independent$mean_expression)
```

```{r}
#Supplemental Figure 6C
mat <- as.matrix(fltlog_TPM_Data)
mode(mat) <- "numeric"

pca <- prcomp(t(mat), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
Scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x)

meta <- metaData2[rownames(Scores), ]

meta_categorical <- meta[, c("Treatment", "Replicate", "Batch", "Timepoint")]


vars <- pca$sdev^2
importance <- vars / sum(vars)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC = seq_along(importance),
  Variance = importance * 100
)

Num <- min(10, nrow(pca_df))


scree <- ggplot(pca_df[1:Num, ], aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey70", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Principal Component") +
  ylab("% Variance Explained")

aov_PC_meta <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(meta_categorical)), function(covar) {

  covar_vec <- meta_categorical[[covar]]

  sapply(1:min(Num, ncol(Scores)), function(PC) {
    summary(aov(Scores[, PC] ~ covar_vec))[[1]]$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  })

})

aov_PC_meta <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, aov_PC_meta))

rownames(aov_PC_meta) <- colnames(meta_categorical)
colnames(aov_PC_meta) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(ncol(aov_PC_meta)))

heat_df <- melt(as.matrix(aov_PC_meta))
colnames(heat_df) <- c("Metadata", "PC", "Pvalue")


heat_df$PvalueClass <- cut(
  heat_df$Pvalue,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
  labels = c("≤0.001", "≤0.01", "≤0.05", ">0.05")
)


heat_df$Metadata <- factor(
  heat_df$Metadata,
  levels = c("Batch", "Replicate", "Treatment", "Timepoint")
)

heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = PC, y = Metadata, fill = PvalueClass)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#08306b", "#4292c6", "#9ecae1", "#f0f0f0")
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  xlab("Principal Component") +
  ylab(NULL)


pdf("PCs_Barplot.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)

grid.arrange(
  scree,
  heat,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(2, 4)
)

dev.off()
```

#Supplemental Figure 6D
#Load Day 7 DGE output
all_genes <- as.character (rownames (res))

signif_CONT <- res[res$padj < 0.05 & res$log2FoldChange < -0.5 & !is.na (res$padj), ]
signif_CONT <- as.character (rownames (signif_CONT))

CONT <- enrichGO (gene          = signif_CONT,
                   universe      = all_genes,
                   keyType       = "SYMBOL",
                   OrgDb         = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                   ont           = "BP",
                   pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                   qvalueCutoff  = 0.05)


cluster_summary_CONT <- data.frame (CONT)

signif_ARNT <- res[res$padj < 0.05 & res$log2FoldChange > 0.5 & !is.na (res$padj), ]
signif_ARNT <- as.character (rownames (signif_ARNT))

ARNT <- enrichGO (gene          = signif_ARNT,
                 universe      = all_genes,
                 keyType       = "SYMBOL",
                 OrgDb         = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                 ont           = "BP",
                 pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                 qvalueCutoff  = 0.05)


cluster_summary_ARNT <- data.frame (ARNT)

      options (enrichplot.colours = c("#76d6ffff", "grey"))
P1 <- dotplot (CONT, showCategory = 20) + xlim (0, 0.15)

      options (enrichplot.colours = c("#5e5e5eff", "grey"))
P2 <- dotplot (ARNT,   showCategory = 20) + xlim (0, 0.15)

pdf("GOTerms.pdf", width = 12, height = 7)
P1 + P2
dev.off()
